programme.title: New Jack City (1991)
programme.desc: Streetwise cops target a megalomaniacal drug lord, whose empire is threatened by an informer.

programme.title: The Great Debaters (2007)
programme.desc: Denzel Washington directed and stars in this inspiring and uplifting true story, which chronicles the rise of a debate team at a small all-black college in Texas that went on to challenge Harvard in the 1930s.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies (2015)
programme.desc: In this historical drama set during the Cold War, an attorney is tasked with negotiating a prisoner exchange between an American pilot who was shot down over the USSR and a Soviet spy serving a 45-year sentence for espionage against the US.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express (1974)
programme.desc: Agatha Christie classic features detective Hercule Poirot attempting to solve a murder on a train.

programme.title: Major League (1989)
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland baseball team puts together a purposely-horrible team so they'll lose and she can move the team. But when the plot is uncovered, they start winning just to spite her.

programme.title: Sahara (2005)
programme.desc: An explorer and his sidekick search for treasure and help a doctor contain a plague in Africa.

programme.title: Judgment Night (1993)
programme.desc: A detour leads four friends into a nightmarish bout with drug-dealing gangsters. Emilio Estevez, Cuba Gooding Jr. Fallon: Denis Leary. Wyatt: Stephen Dorff. Cochran: Jeremy Piven. Sykes: Peter Greene. Rhodes: Erik Schrody. Travis: Michael Wiseman. Directed by Stephen Hopkins.

programme.title: The Haunting (1999)
programme.desc: Four people spend the night in a supposedly haunted mansion as an experiment in this remake of the 1963 classic.

programme.title: Limitless (2011)
programme.desc: Struggling author Eddie Morra overcomes his writer's block with a new drug that unlocks the full potential of his brain, and he forges a partnership with a businessman seeking to capitalise on his extraordinary skills. Meanwhile, some dangerous characters discover Eddie's secret and come gunning for his dwindling supply of the pharmaceutical.

programme.title: The Contractor (2022)
programme.desc: Ex-Marine James Harper takes up arms in a paramilitary unit after his involuntary discharge from the Special Forces leaves him scrambling to make ends meet for his family. On a covert mission abroad, Harper soon finds himself caught in a violent feud, forcing him to find a way home by any means necessary.

programme.title: Hell or High Water (2016)
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County (2023)
programme.desc: At a middle-of-nowhere truck stop in Arizona, lives will collide as a traveling knife salesman gets caught up in a hostage situation. A pair of violent bank robbers are stranded with the salesman waiting for a gas truck. When the town's residents gather in the local diner, things get a little crazy as they realize the robbers are there, along with the money they stole.

programme.title: The Last Manhunt (2022)
programme.desc: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their "murdered" tribal leader.

programme.title: Red (2010)
programme.desc: Retired CIA hit man Frank Moses and his former colleagues race to find out why they've been targeted for death by their former organisation and uncover a vast conspiracy implicating some prominent politicians in the process.

programme.title: Sound of Violence (2021)
programme.desc: As a child, the brutal murder of her family made Alexis regain her hearing along with synesthetic abilities. Now as an adult, she finds solace in the sounds of bodily harm. But when she's told she might lose her hearing again, she escalates her gruesome sound experiments in a quest to compose her masterpiece.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives (2004)
programme.desc: Frank Oz's remake of the 1975 thriller is a pointed black comedy with a sublime A-list cast. Nicole Kidman stars as a former TV exec who suspects something is amiss when all of her new neighbors seem programmed to please their husbands. Matthew Broderick costars as her Milquetoast husband. Bette Midler, Faith Hill, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken, Jon Lovitz.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles (1974)
programme.desc: Mel Brooks' send-up of Hollywood Westerns.

programme.title: Rumours (2024)
programme.desc: At an exclusive political summit, seven world leaders get hopelessly lost in misty woods while drafting a crisis statement. As night falls, their predicament turns from comedic to horrific, with surreal encounters testing their already questionable leadership abilities and exposing the absurdity of power.

programme.title: Mona Lisa and the Blood Moon (2021)
programme.desc: Having lived her life in a psychiatric facility, a young girl with extraordinary abilities vows to make her own way in the world. Upon her escape, she explores New Orleans, encountering a host of new experiences and people that alter her perspective on her sheltered, unusual life.

programme.title: Virtuosity (1995)

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 2 of the Western Conference finals. From Paycom Center. The Wolves' postseason road prowess (10-3 last two years) hit a speed bump with a 114-88 loss in Game 1 after leading by four at the half. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander tallied 31 points and nine assists, while Jalen Williams added 19 with five steals. The OKC bench shot 8-of-11 from distance.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 4 of the Western Conference finals. From Target Center. The T-Wolves trail the series 2-1 but look to ride the momentum from a 143-101 Game 3 drubbing of OKC sparked by stars Anthony Edwards (30 points in 30 min.) and Julius Randle (24 pts.). The Thunder are 3-3 on the road this postseason, with no winning margin of more than six points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Los Angeles Lakers in Game 5 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Crypto.com Arena. J.J. Redick's Lakers come home staring at elimination after a 116-113 T-Wolves win in Game 4 behind Anthony Edwards' 43 points and clutch late play from Jaden McDaniels. LeBron James scored 27, but none in the fourth quarter, which Minnesota has controlled in the series.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Memphis Grizzlies in Game 3 of a Western Conference first-round series. From FedExForum. The Grizzlies return to Tennessee singin' the blues after an empty two-game trip to OKC in which the Thunder never trailed after the opening minutes of Game 1. Mark Daigneault's top-seeded squad committed just seven turnovers in Game 2 and had 16 steals/blocks to eight for Memphis.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Memphis Grizzlies in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From FedExForum. Top-seeded OKC survived a 29-point deficit in Game 3 en route to a 114-108 victory and a 3-0 series lead. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 31 and Jalen Williams added 26, including the go-ahead free throw that game the Thunder their first lead with 1:20 to play. Scottie Pippen tallied 28 in defeat.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers in Game 1 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Rocket Arena. Kenny Atkinson's top-seeded Cavs get back to action after sweeping their first-round series by an average of 30.5 points, with star guard Donovan Mitchell sharing the spotlight with Indiana's Tyrese Haliburton. Cleveland took the teams' last two playoff meetings in 2017 and 2018 (1st Rd.).

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers in Game 3 of the Eastern Conference finals. Rick Carlisle's Pacers come home on Indy 500 Day looking to pull away from the Knicks after grinding out wins in the first two games in New York City. Ninth-year forward Pascal Siakam exploded for 39 points in Game 2, while Jalen Brunson's 39.5 ppg and eight assists/game have not been enough for the Knicks, who now look to build on their 5-1 road record this postseason.
